posts.title: So I Built (Another) Woodshed
posts.description: Eleven years ago, I built a woodshed at our old house. Mistakes were made, but overall it did what it was built to do, and I learned a lot in the process. Five years later we moved to the island, and the new house came with its own woodshed. The shed we inherited had two major issues, however. First, it was too small for our usage. posts.title: 60 Miles
posts.description: Over 1100 days ago, I went for a 50 mile walk. There was no particular reason for it. I wasn’t walking as part of an event, it wasn’t part of a group charity drive and it wasn’t to get anywhere. I never left my island, in fact. As someone who enjoys walking and walking long distances, it just seemed like a logical next step having walked a marathon distance six months earlier.

posts.title: Books: Spring 2026
posts.description: Having promised myself if no one else that it wouldn’t be another eight year span in between book reviews, here I am back four months later.
